correctness.rationale: Commuting shifts and OR idempotence give offsets t+j(s−1), j=0,...,t, in the t-step dependence. Within the rotated source class the order has period m because (s−1)/g is coprime to m. Every class saturates to its OR at time m−1; thereafter the class-constant states rotate bijectively, so this set is exactly the recurrent locus. For 0<=t<m, a zero class qualifies separately; a nonzero class qualifies precisely when its largest cyclic run of zeros is <=t. Every qualifying nonzero word gives a unique marked closed path in the run-length automaton because ones reset the state; an all-zero word has no closed path. This proves the trace census, and at t=m−2 exactly the m singleton words per class fail, including the m=2 boundary. The saturated map tests one bit of information per source class, so one phase with w active classes has (2^m−1)^w inputs and the orbit basin sums d disjoint phases. At t=h+c−1, any bad nonzero class is exactly an occurrence of 1 followed by h+c zeros. Overlaps are incompatible and disjoint blocks independent; for each fixed factorial moment j only O_j(m^(j−1)(h+c)) ordered start tuples are lost. The moments converge to those of Poisson(2^(−c−1)); applying the zero-count probability and independence across g classes gives the stated limit. The fixed g,c and sufficiently large h ensure admissible offsets and block lengths. Independent functional-graph peeling plus cyclic inclusion-exclusion and direct phase-fiber enumeration agreed across 45 systems and 32776 starts (3<=n<=11, all allowed s). Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/independent_reproduction.py 2.
residual_risks: Finite enumeration does not prove the general formula or the limiting law.

General disjunctive periodic-point and circular-run comparisons
value.rationale: For the natural synchronous disjunctive system the result measures more than a known periodic skeleton: one gcd controls the full labelled entry distribution, phase weights, and the separation between sharp worst-case and stochastic clocks. Changing the second jump while keeping n fixed can change the entire distribution. The network-specific link to an exact run statistic makes the basin and transient law useful as benchmarks for disjunctive systems, even though the run formulas themselves are classical.
residual_risks: The complete result treats two incoming OR offsets, not arbitrary circulant dependency sets or heterogeneous updates.
